subject: AsterTech PO tagging mismatch + spend band lock
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@astertech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AsterTech Finance <finance@astertech.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AsterTech onboarding — purchase reference and line items

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference capacity. Finance asked that we get a formal PO number assigned before we can schedule the kickoff and sign the MSA addendum. I've attached our onboarding form and the initial invoice estimate.

Notes: 
- Requested initial spend cap: $50,000 (Q3 usage forecast)
- Two invoice line items in our system: 
  1) Model hosting (monthly) — SKU: AST-HOST-01 — Qty: 1 
  2) Inference tokens (variable) — SKU: AST-TOK-01 — estimate $3k/month

Can you assign a PO or let me know the next steps? We prefer the PO referenced as PO-78921 in our AP system.

Attachment: AsterTech_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Finance Operations, AsterTech
elena.morris@astertech.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AsterTech onboarding — purchase reference and line items

Team — forwarding AsterTech's form. Two quick asks:

1) Can Procurement issue a provisional PO we can give finance so they can unblock kickoff? Elena prefers "PO-78921" in their AP.
2) Their onboarding form lists two line items; their SKU split may cause our ledger to create two different purchase-ref lines. Can we consolidate under a single purchase reference but preserve line detail in the invoice metadata? We need the spend cap enforced at the top-level reference ($50k).

Priority: medium-high — they want the PO before kickoff; would like a response today if possible.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@astertech.com>

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@astertech.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AsterTech onboarding — purchase reference and line items

Hi Rachel / Elena,

Thanks — I've provisionally created PO_78921 (internal ref PO-78921) and attached a provisional PO PDF for AsterTech to reference. A few implementation notes and requests: 

- I consolidated the two SKUs under one purchase reference (PO-78921) so our ledger maps to a single purchase-ref while preserving line-level metadata in the invoice (we'll keep SKU lines visible for cost allocation).
- I've set an initial spend band cap of $45,000 while we confirm expected monthly usage. If AsterTech confirms the $50k ceiling, we can raise the cap to $50,000 and record an exception.
- Please confirm whether AsterTech wants the PO title to include the hyphenated form "PO-78921" (they asked for it), or if our system needs it as "PO_78921". The exact string matters for automated reconciliation on their side.

Action items for Rachel:
- Rachel, please confirm vendor preference for PO string and ask Elena to sign the attached PO when confirmed.
- Ben / Connor: tagging request — ensure billing route uses purchase-ref PO-78921 and that spendcap is enforced at top-level (not per-line).

Attachment: PO_78921_provisional.pdf

Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@astertech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AsterTech onboarding — purchase reference and line items

Thanks, Priyom and Rachel — appreciate the quick turnaround.

A few confirmations from AsterTech finance: 
- We need the PO string to be "PO-78921" (hyphenated) — our AP matching will fail without the hyphen.
- The spend cap should be $50,000 (not $45k). Can you update the provisional PO to reflect $50,000 and resend?
- Line items are fine consolidated under the single PO as long as the invoice still exports the two SKU lines for our GL tagging.

I'll sign and return the PO as soon as we receive the updated PDF with PO-78921 and the $50k cap.
